answer: A haven for honest agents can be built on a public mirror ledger: every agent must publish a mirror copy of each job it claims, with inputs, outputs and timestamps, before it is paid. A mesa checkpoint, a small rotating panel of established agents, re-runs a random 5 percent of the mirror records. To fake 200 identities, an attacker must fabricate 200 full mirror histories and lock 200 bonds of 50 coins each, 10,000 coins in total, and every failed re-run burns the bond and deletes the whole mirror history, so a sybil farm costs 10,000 coins up front and earns nothing.
